text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose...! I won't!! Especially not 
to you...!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —...*chuckle* Do pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
What I'm looking at... is far beyond that! 
HAAAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh! Aaaaarrrrggghhh...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Gentildonna! 
Gentildonnaa--!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Donning the final crown! She has proven 
her own strength!"
(Waaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...The Triple Tiara slipped through my 
fingers. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Phase one cleared, then.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Everyone!!

A sharp, commanding voice cut through the 
commotion of the venue— and in an instant, 
total silence fell.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Once again, thank you all for welcoming me 
with such loud cheers.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Today marks yet another new beginning... 
Everyone, please be sure not to miss a 
single moment.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
With this power I showed you today... I 
shall claim everything.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... You are all truly fortunate, to 
have been born in an era graced by none 
other than myself.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text: ...! So that's... Gentildonna...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
"—So gorgeous, so strong... She's just so 
cool...!!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Ugh, uuuuugh...! ...Aah... Aaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...This... wasn't supposed to— It's 
w-wrong...! But...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I will stand at the pinnacle... Because 
I... I am—

Welcoming today's magnificent victor with 
heartfelt applause... She has truly proven 
her strength.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "That is one... accomplished."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: And? What are your thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I can tell just from looking into your 
eyes. Thank you so much.

It seems this particular compliment was to 
Gentildonna's liking. Just then—

She seemed somewhat different from 
before... Today's display of strength from 
Gentildonna may have looked daunting to 
her.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations. Excuse me—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Verxina-san.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work. ...You 
showed tremendous spirit.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"You honed your own running and showed us 
magnificent tenacity."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: It was all— in order to defeat me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
In other words, my power elevated you... 
and your presence lit a fire in me as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: You are strong.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...I see. That's right...! Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: That is why I shall move forward.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It's the same as training. Once you 
achieve one goal, you apply a heavier 
load.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that just how you climb to your next 
battleground?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: O-On the spot...?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Where do you think it is?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Surely you too... can now see the heights 
we aim for, yes?

Today, Gentildonna demonstrated her power. 
In that case, what she desires next... is—
choice_data_list:
(An "opponent" against whom she can 
unleash all that power...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Japan's Orfevre takes 2nd place!! She gave 
us hope right until the very finish line!

"Though victory at the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe eluded her, Orfevre showed the 
world her strength—and they will surely 
want a showdown with her."

And the race Orfevre has declared her 
entry for is... A GⅠ race where the era's 
strongest Umamusume gather—
choice_data_list: Our next stage will be—the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: That's right!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Japan... Cup...――

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If you still require my chaperoning, then 
by all means, do come along as well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I suspect it will end the same way as 
today, though... Ho ho ho.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...W-With who I am right now, not yet... 
...Now is not the time."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...P-Pardon me...!!

The look on Verxina's face as she walked 
away... The fire was completely gone from 
her eyes. Even for her, that must have 
taken quite a heavy toll.
choice_data_list: I wonder if she can get back on her feet.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If you don't stand back up, it all ends 
right there.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Precisely because she understood it on 
instinct, she chose to step back for now."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You must realize that blindly charging in 
like this will only yield the exact same 
result.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The more you try to break her, the more 
brilliantly she blooms. Make sure you 
overcome your weaknesses from last time, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"If you're still shedding tears the next 
time we meet... then I will have misjudged 
you."
choice_data_list: (So you really do recognize it, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Is this really the time to stand there 
smiling and spacing out?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
This is where you show your skill as a 
Trainer. —Present the ultimate plan for 
me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, you yourself... must have grown 
since the summer as well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Show me power worthy of the next stage. I 
can count on you, can't I?

My heart is pounding... At last, we'll be 
competing in earnest against Senior Class 
Umamusume—

Seeking the title of the strongest of this 
era... I set my sights on the Japan Cup, 
where the mighty gather.
